name: generate_barcode
description: Generate a barcode image of the specified type encoding the given data. Returns the image as base64-encoded content.

arguments.name: barcode_type
arguments.desc: Barcode symbology (e.g., QR, Code128, DataMatrix, EAN13, PDF417)

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Data to encode in the barcode

arguments.name: image_format
arguments.desc: Output format: PNG (default), JPEG, SVG, GIF, TIFF

arguments.name: text_location
arguments.desc: Text position: Below, Above, None. Default depends on barcode type

name: recognize_barcode
description: Recognize barcodes of a specific type from a base64-encoded image. Allows specifying barcode types and recognition quality.

arguments.name: barcode_type
arguments.desc: Types to look for (e.g., QR, Code128). Default: most commonly used types

arguments.name: recognition_mode
arguments.desc: Quality vs speed: Fast, Normal (default), Excellent

name: scan_barcode
description: Automatically detect and read most common barcodes in a base64-encoded image without specifying barcode type.

name: list_barcode_types
description: List all supported barcode types for generation and recognition.
